name: alphaosint-prospector
description: B2B prospecting inside Claude. Finds companies that are hiring for the roles you sell into, adds LinkedIn and Crunchbase data, scores them 0-100 against your ICP, and finds decision-makers with verified emails. Research only, it sends nothing.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your token from Apify Console > Settings > Integrations. Actor runs are billed to this Apify account.

apify_tier.title: Apify plan tier
apify_tier.description: Your Apify plan, used to price tiered events in the spend log.

session_budget_usd.title: Session budget (USD)
session_budget_usd.description: Hard cap on Apify spend per Claude session. The email step needs at least 0.50 left.
